messages:
Ibrahim (AE): Starlight CISO put the POC on hold. They want a one-page exec note + a minimal runbook proving deterministic egress (fixed NAT IPs) and 90d audit export. Need package by Tue AM for their steering committee.
Nina (SE): Copy. Quick question: are they asking for Dedicated/Private or will Hosted + reserved egress IPs + retention addon be acceptable?
Ibrahim (AE): They said speed is important but CISO says board prefers Dedicated controls. They asked for comparison and an explicit acceptance checklist.
Priya (Security): TL;DR: Hosted can provide per-request logs and we can export logs, but retention >31 days requires the retention addon. We do not have tenant-level FQDN blocking on hosted; that requires Dedicated/Private or a customer-side proxy.
Marco (Infra): We can reserve static NAT egress IPs for a tenant (INFRA-9100). That gives a deterministic set of source IPs. True outbound host blocking only on Dedicated.
Rachel (SalesOps): Pricing note: Dedicated uplift ~+33% MRR; 90d retention is an add-on monthly fee. Need approval to show numbers to the customer. Ibrahim, ok to show both options?
Ibrahim (AE): Yes, show both with clear tradeoffs and a short migration path (hosted -> dedicated). If they want speed, recommend hosted+retention as the fast path.
Priya (Security): I'll draft a 2-paragraph exec summary (risk posture + recommended remediation) and an acceptance checklist CISO can tick off.
Nina (SE): I'll assemble the one-page runbook: 1) overview & constraints 2) inbound allowlist example CIDRs 3) what we can/can't block 4) log export steps 5) rollback steps. I'll keep it copy/paste friendly.
Marco (Infra): ops-bot, open INFRA-9100 to reserve static NAT IPs for tenant-starlight and generate ACL template.
ops-bot: Created INFRA-9100: Reserve static NAT IPs for tenant-starlight and generate ACL template. Assigned to infra-scheduling.
Nina (SE): Runbook draft snippet: ```
Inbound allowlist (examples): 3.236.45.0/24, 52.14.99.0/24
Steps:
- Confirm INFRA-9100 reserved IPs
- Customer applies inbound allowlist to firewall
- Run egress validation: `./tools/egress_test.sh --target blocked.example` -> expect logged event
- Export logs: /console/logs/export?tenant=starlight&days=90 -> validate CSV contains request_id, timestamp, dst_host
Rollback:
- Revert ACLs to previous policy tag `starlight-prechange-2026-03-01`
- Reroute traffic to stable-model-pool
- Notify infra-oncall and customer SRE
```
Rachel (SalesOps): I'll draft the legal-ready memo including a short liability paragraph and the pricing appendix. ETA 4 hours after INFRA-9100 confirms NAT IPs.
Priya (Security): Proposed acceptance checklist: ["Static NAT IPs reserved and verified", "90d log export validated (sample CSV)", "Blocked-host egress attempt recorded and logged", "Rollback procedure tested and documented"]. I'll include recommended wording for counsel.
Ibrahim (AE): Customer also asked for minimal wording about responsibility for outbound actions during the POC. Rachel/Priya can you coordinate with Legal?
Rachel (SalesOps): Will loop in Legal on the wording. Drafted candidate line: "Redwood will provide the network controls described; customer and Redwood will jointly validate egress behavior during the POC." Will get counsel sign-off.
Marco (Infra): Timeline: if INFRA-9100 is prioritized today, NAT IPs by Mon morning; otherwise Tue. I'll ping infra-scheduling.
Nina (SE): I'll post the final one-pager + exec summary here once Legal okays the wording and INFRA-9100 confirms IPs.
Ibrahim (AE): Thanks team. This is critical for closing. Please drop final runbook + exec note + INFRA-9100 link here so I can send to their CISO Tue AM. :pray:
